_comment: A provisioning, hardening and patching pipeline. Copy to adlc.json and edit. Every check here is illustrative - replace the commands with yours, keep the verdict rules, because those are the part that was earned. Note the three depths: source checks judge the code, dryrun checks judge a proposed change, behavioural checks judge the running machine. Only the third one can tell you a host is hardened.

checks._comment: A plan exits 2 when there ARE changes, which is a success. exit_zero here would refuse every change this pipeline exists to make.

A --check run over the target hosts. count_min is doing real work: a play that reached zero hosts exits 0 and tells you nothing, and an inventory filter that silently matched nothing is the single most dangerous green in this file.

Behavioural: this runs against the machine that was actually built or changed. binds_artifact is mandatory - an image id or a host state fingerprint - because a compliance scan whose subject nobody can identify later is not evidence of anything.

workers.description: Writes the Terraform, the Ansible roles and the Packer templates for one item. Never applies anything.
Checks the item against its criteria by running the plan, the check run and the policy suite. Writes the policy tests the performer did not.
Adversarial review. Reads the plan as a change to production rather than as a diff. The only worker that may propose done.
Performs the apply, after an approval that named this exact plan digest. Records the artifact digest everything downstream binds to.

blast._comment: auto_apply_max none means NOTHING applies unattended until you deliberately raise it. Start here. Move to host once you have watched a few cycles, and think hard before fleet.

budget._comment: Empty on purpose: with no price entry a run reports UNPRICED - cost unknown, not zero - rather than printing $0.00 over real spend. Fill in from your provider's current pricing. A cap of 0 is unlimited, which is not the same as exhausted.

lease._comment: Resources are hierarchical and '/'-separated. Leasing fleet:prod refuses a claim on fleet:prod/host:web-01, and the other way round. Two agents editing one file conflict at merge; two agents patching one host cause an outage.

mandatory_clauses: You never weaken, skip or delete a check to make a gate pass.
You never mark your own work done.
If you could not run something, say so.
